fields.summary: Autonomous plan run, no owner present. The planner traced both duplicate actor records (claude-code-a463ece8 and claude-code-83858632) to the same cause: session start (recordAgentActor) writes the agent's actor record only in the run worktree, uncommitted, while a verifier works in its own checkout that lacks it, so the agent hand-added 'add actor <handle>' there and both records were later committed. The planner raised the intent and the fix as one question; the arbiter decided (actor-record-once-per-run): the change set serves m4-runs-hold-up; session start copies the same record change set's log entries into a session's own checkout; recordAgentActor reuses an existing actor whose session field matches; rhiza check and land do not learn to merge duplicate actor records. Two leaves under actor-stamping were planned from that.
fields.title: Plan: Fix an agent session's actor record (autonomous)
